newsitem.title: USA: Equity partnership files $500 mln shelf debt.
newsitem.headline: Equity partnership files $500 mln shelf debt.

text.p: ERP Operating Ltd. Partnership filed Wednesday a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $500 million in debt securities.
ERP is an operating partnership managed by Equity Residential Properties Trust, its general partner, according to the filing.
Net proceeds form the partnership's offering will be used for general business purposes, including repaymemt of debt and acquisition of multifamily residential properties.
Equity Residential was formed to continue the real estate businesses of affiliates of investor Samuel Zell, chairman of the firm's board of trustees.
